title: Dinar's Creative Props
description: CIT Resource Pack for the Create and Create Deco mods that adds various props
body:
About
---
Want to add a little detail to your Create factories? Download Dinar's Creative Props! This resource pack adds numerous brick piles or Create elements, various decals, metal furniture, and awards!

This resource pack requires a **CIT mod**. The models were designed to be placed in **invisible frames**. For your survival worlds, please find any mods or data packs that allow you to get invisible frames.
